description: November 8 birthday meaning: Scorpio decan 2, birthday number 8, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a November 8 birthday falls in Scorpio, in the second decan, with Pluto as the sign's ruler and Neptune as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 8. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Scorpio is fixed and water.

sections.heading: Personality of a November 8 birthday
paragraphs: Fifteen degrees of Scorpio, the middle of the sign, gives November 8 a concentrated Scorpionic character, with Neptune's imagination as decan sub-ruler. The birthday number 8 adds ambition and an instinct for resources. Interpretively, this is a visionary strategist: someone who can picture an outcome vividly and then pursue it with patience, discretion and unusual stamina.

By noon UTC on November 8, the Sun has normally reached roughly 15° of Scorpio. That places the date in the Scorpio decan that astrologers give to Neptune, the second of three. From 10 to 19 degrees of Scorpio, the sub-ruler is Neptune, modern ruler of Pisces. Early-to-mid November birthdays tend to soften the sign's intensity with intuition, imagination and empathy. These Scorpios are often seen as perceptive in an almost uncanny way, reading undercurrents in a room and drawn to art, healing work or spiritual questions. Neptune can blur edges, so feelings may be absorbed from others or idealised beyond recognition. The combination is powerful when grounded: deep emotional insight paired with compassion, used to help people face what they would rather not see alone.

sections.heading: Numerology of the November 8 birthday
paragraphs: A birthday on the 8th gives a birthday number of 8 with nothing to reduce. In numerology the day of birth works as a supporting number, a practical aptitude that colours the Life Path. The 8, drawn as two stacked loops, is traditionally linked with balance between the material and inner worlds, and with authority, organisation and ambition. People born on the 8th are often seen as capable managers of money, time and teams. They may also be hard on themselves when results lag. Generosity with the influence they build is commonly regarded as the 8's best expression.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same November 8 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 1 for 1980, 2 for 1990, 3 for 2000 and 22 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: November 8 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: A November birthday falls in late autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of bare branches and early dusk, and in late spring for the southern, when the days lengthen fast. Scorpio holds most of the month, with Sagittarius arriving around November 22. In numerology November is month 11, a master number that is traditionally kept unreduced and linked with intuition and inspiration. November 8 is the 312nd day of the year (313rd in a leap year). In most years Sagittarius season is under way by November 23, 15 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a November 8 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. November 8 is also the birthday of Alain Delon (1935), Kazuo Ishiguro (1954) and Gottlob Frege (1848).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is November 8?
faq.answer: November 8 is Scorpio in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Scorpio, which tradition links with Neptune.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on November 8?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On November 8 the Life Path is 8 in 1960, 9 in 1970, 1 in 1980, 2 in 1990, 3 in 2000, 22 in 2010 and 5 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 8 for everyone born on the 8th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on November 8?
faq.answer: By November 8 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on November 8?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a November 8 birthday are Alain Delon (1935), Kazuo Ishiguro (1954) and Gottlob Frege (1848). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
